deadline.value: April 15 online submission deadline for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: The online submission deadline is when the initial application must be submitted online, provided the department has no earlier deadline. By the file completion deadline, admission must be granted and all documents required to obtain a student visa must be submitted to the Division of Global Engagement.

gre_general.value: Graduate Record Examination scores required for admission.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination scores. A minimum grade point average of 3.0 out of 4.0.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Biology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree required per university graduate admission policies.
entry_route.quote: Admission to graduate study requires a bachelor’s degree with a satisfactory grade point average (GPA) from a college or university accredited by the appropriate regional accrediting agency, an institution accredited by another organization recognized by the Council on Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), or foreign equivalent.
